fusions.name: Panopticon
fusions.desc: Sweeps a gaze in a full circle that deals 28 damage to every enemy within 4 tiles, ignores their resistances and leaves each one [Marked] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Fixed Stare
fusions.desc: A stare that deals 12 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Stunned] for 1.2 seconds. Its damage rises 10% for every affliction on the target (max 40%).

fusions.name: Lamp-Room Sweep
fusions.desc: After a 0.8 second cast, plants a lamp that stands for 15 seconds. Every 1.5 seconds it hits an enemy within 6 tiles for 5 damage, with a 30% chance to leave the target [Marked] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Unbroken Watch
fusions.desc: Your critical strike chance rises by 8%, and your other abilities come round 5% sooner.
